title: Property grid
summary: A property inspector: fields in collapsible groups (text, number, select, switch), each a labelled real control, with per-property validation and a pk-property-change event. Uses the same field vocabulary as pk-settings-page.

props.name: config
props.description: { groups: [{ heading, collapsed?, fields: [{ key, type: 'text'|'number'|'select'|'switch', label, required?, disabled?, options?, min?, max?, step? }] }] }. A select's options are [{ value, label? }] or plain strings.

props.name: values
props.description: The property values keyed by field key; set again to update the controls (for example when the selected object changes).

props.name: errors
props.description: Host-side validation messages keyed by field key (for example from a server); shown under the property and marking it invalid. Built-in rules (required, number min/max) apply as well.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every property (a field's own disabled: true stays disabled either way).

events.name: pk-property-change
events.detail: { key: string, value: any, values: object, valid: boolean }
events.description: The user committed a new value for one property; carries every current value and whether all properties are valid.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: A placeholder message shown while config.groups is empty.

parts.name: groups
parts.description: The pk-accordion holding one pk-accordion-item per group.

a11y: Each property is a labelled real control (pk-input, pk-select, pk-switch), so Tab, arrow keys and Space work as in those elements; groups are pk-accordion-item disclosures (Enter or Space toggles). An invalid property sets aria-invalid and shows its message as a pk-alert next to it, so an error is never colour alone.

examples.title: Grouped properties; Width is below its minimum, so it shows its validation message
